title: Concordance Hub for Key Customers and Rolling Roadmap Curation
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Create a lightweight Concordance Hub: a single operational surface that gathers top-account signals, normalizes competing feature asks, and produces a rolling 90-day prioritized delivery slate for engineering and GTM. This ticket scopes the PM-side intake, scoring, and curation rules plus the handoff artifacts that engineering and sales can act on without ad-hoc triage meetings.
background: Repeated escalation cycles and ad-hoc priority swaps cause scope churn for Dedicated and Private customers. Current intake spreadsheets diverge across AE, CSM, and Solutions teams. We need a repeatable mechanism that produces a transparent, defensible prioritized view tied to release windows, risk profiles, and measurable engineering effort estimates.
goals: Reduce emergent priority swap meeting time by 60%
Ship a rolling 90-day slate with estimated sprint allocations for each item
Make acceptance criteria and rollback policies explicit for high-touch account commitments
Provide per-item customer impact justification and telemetry knobs for tracking
out_of_scope: Full automation of routing to Dedicated capacity (engineering infra work will be tracked separately)
acceptance_criteria: Concordance Hub proto exists in a Google Sheet and a linked Confluence page with canonical scoring logic
Top-20 accounts mapped to account tiers, ARR, renewal window, and named request owners
Each queued request includes: ask summary, strategic rationale, estimated engineering points, rollback/fallback policy, and required compliance checks
Stakeholders (AE/CS/PM/Eng) have reviewed and approved the scoring rubric in a cross-functional working session
Metrics dashboard (Looker/Grafana link) shows accepted items with baseline signals: request volume, error rate delta risk, and estimated cost-to-serve
scoring_model_summary: Weighted Opportunity Score = 0.4 * ARR_impact + 0.25 * strategic_fit + 0.15 * renewal_proximity + 0.1 * implementation_risk_score + 0.1 * customer_health_index. Scores normalized 0-100 and bucketed into Immediate / Near-term / Watchlist / Reject lanes.
tradeoffs_considered: Favoring ARR-driven asks may deprioritize smaller high-strategic-value customers; mitigated by a 'strategic uplift' flag requiring 2 exec sponsors
Locking roadmap lanes reduces flexibility for opportunistic engineering optimizations; propose quarterly buffer (10-15%) for runway swaps
Automated scoring reduces debate but can miss nuance; retain manual override with audit logging
deliverables: Concordance Hub Confluence doc with scoring rubric and governance playbook
Editable Google Sheet prototype for intake + scoring
Weekly curation template sent to Eng leads with sprint-allocation recommendations
One training session recording for AE/CS workflows
Dashboard tile in Console showing top-account roadmap commitments and rollback status
tasks: Draft scoring rubric and mapping of signals (PM)
Prototype intake sheet and link to Confluence (PM + DEX)
Run two dry-run curation sessions with top-5 accounts (PM + Eng + Sales)
Synchronize with ENG to get standard estimation buckets and capacity model (Eng)
Add a 'commitment terms' template for legal / billing (Legal)
Build a Console dashboard tile prototype using existing telemetry (Observability)
Write handoff playbook for canary/rollback for Dedicated and Private releases (PM + Eng)
metrics: Number of roadmap swaps per quarter (target -60% vs prior)
Percent of accepted items with tracked regressions or rollbacks (target < 10%)
Customer satisfaction post-delivery (NPS delta for impacted accounts)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): build prototype docs and scoring rubric. Phase 2 (3 weeks): run dry-runs with top-5 accounts, iterate rubric. Phase 3 (4 weeks): launch 90-day rolling slate cadence + Console dashboard prototype. Phase 4 (ongoing): weekly curation meetings, quarterly rubric calibration and retrospective.
risk_and_mitigation: Over-indexing on revenue signals -> mitigation: mandatory strategic-uptick review requiring exec sponsor
Engineering capacity estimate inaccuracy -> mitigation: conservative buffer + capacity simulator integration (ENG-2842)
Stakeholder buy-in failure -> mitigation: early demo sessions and documented decision audit logs
communication_plan: Weekly email to AEs/CS with current slate and reasoning. Bi-weekly sync with Eng release management. Confluence updated after each curation meeting with decisions and ticket links.
review_feedback: Design reviewed: prefer a short single-line rationale per request and a link to detailed PRD
Sales asked for explicit renewal impact field (added to intake template)
Eng requested default rollback policy templates for Dedicated/private work
qa_criteria: Intake template populated for 10 sample requests without missing fields
Scoring calculation reproducible and unit-tested in the prototype sheet
Dashboard tile shows at least 3 items with linked ticket references
notes: This hub is intentionally PM-led but will require weekly 60-minute cross-functional curation calls
We will instrument telemetry events for 'commitment made' and 'rollback executed' to measure downstream cost and risk
Consider future integration with Redwood Console rollouts API to automate canary gating for customer-specific commits
